title: 1992 AHSME Problem 3
statement: If \(m\gt0\) and the points \((m,3)\) and \((1,m)\) lie on a line with slope \(m,\) then \(m=\)

solutions.text:
The slope condition gives \[ \frac{m-3}{1-m}=m. \] Therefore \(m-3=m-m^2,\) so \(m^2=3.\) Since \(m\gt0,\) we obtain \(m=\sqrt3.\)

Thus the correct answer is C.
